notes.title: Demo v1.29.6
notes.notes:
Greetings! Thank you for playing the demo! I hope you're enjoying it so far (and if you are, please consider adding the game to your wishlist and dropping a review for the demo ❤️)

Anyhoo, I've been working to patch out some issues. Here's a quick rundown!

[list]
[*] Fixed leaderboard score retrieval range for affected players
[*] Penguin now pulses to the beat in the gameover screen's leaderboard
[*] Added support for screenshot taking in-game (Press F12)
[*] Minor UI fixes
[*] CRT toggle now works properly
[*] Minimum window size implemented
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45537305/e5df2840a100aea1c5d5d5a351a20d275cf94926.jpg[/img]
[i]Thank you for playing, you absolute legends![/i]

notes.title: A Slight Chance of Sawblades is a fun high-score chaser with a demo out now
notes.notes:
For readers who like their smaller, faster more casual high-score chasers you'll want to check out A Slight Chance of Sawblades.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/a-slight-chance-of-sawblades-is-a-fun-high-score-chaser-with-a-demo-out-now/

notes.title: Demo is out!!
notes.notes:
A Slight Chance of Sawblades finally has a demo! Give it a spin :D
Play [b]Classic Mode[/b] right now with zero limitations, and participate in the leaderboard! My current score in the leaderboard is [b]296[/b] - try beating that! 🔥

notes.title: Demo coming very soon!
notes.notes:
Good news everyone, the demo is almost ready for release! 

It will feature Classic Mode - entirely playable without any restrictions. The demo will also offer a small taste of the various unlockable skins the full game will offer! I was also able to test the game on the [b]Steam Deck[/b] - and it works great! Naturally, I will continue to add to the game, that includes adding Achievements to the full version of the game, looking into gamepad haptics/vibrations, amongst other things. 

Stay tuned!
